facts.text: The Lodge at Blue Sky sits just beyond Park City and spans 4,000 private acres of wilderness.
facts.excerpt: Just beyond Park City, The Lodge at Blue Sky spans 4,000 private acres of untamed wilderness.

facts.text: The design is modern and organic, and cliffside accommodations overlook creeks and peaks.
facts.excerpt: Modern, organic design blends into the landscape, where cliffside accommodations overlook creeks and sunlit peaks.

facts.text: The Creek Houses are one-bedroom suites on the banks of Alexander Creek, a short walk from the Sky Lodge and Edge Spa.
facts.excerpt: The Creek Houses are open concept, one-bedroom suites situated along the tranquil banks of Alexander Creek, just a 3 minute walk from the Sky Lodge and Edge Spa.

facts.text: The Creek Houses are adult-only suites with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: These adult-only suites offer floor-to-ceiling windows to showcase the lush surroundings

facts.text: Each Earth Suite has a private terrace with an outdoor fireplace, and all offer connecting options for families.
facts.excerpt: Each suite offers a private terrace with an outdoor fireplace and sweeping views of a snow-covered Alexander Canyon. All offer connecting options, making these suites ideal for families or those seeking additional space.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Signature Suites are in the central Sky Lodge and suit families or guests wanting more space.
facts.excerpt: these accommodations, located in the central Sky Lodge, are perfectly suited to families or those seeking more space in which to relax

facts.text: The resort is a 40-minute drive from Salt Lake City International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The Lodge at Blue Sky is approximately 43 miles, or a 40-minute drive, from Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC).

facts.text: Private airport transfers can be arranged through the resort for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Private airport transfers can be arranged year-round through the resort for an additional fee.

facts.text: Spring through fall suits horseback riding, hiking and fly-fishing, and winter brings skiing and snowshoeing.
facts.excerpt: Spring through fall is ideal for horseback riding, hiking, fly-fishing and sporting pursuits, while winter brings skiing, snowshoeing and other snow-filled adventures in and around Park City.

facts.text: The resort has a private Ski Lounge at Park City Mountain Resort and can arrange ski transportation and equipment rentals.
facts.excerpt: Blue Sky offers a private Ski Lounge at Park City Mountain Resort, providing a convenient home base for days on the slopes.

facts.text: The High West Distillery is on the resort's property and offers whiskey tastings and distillery tours.
facts.excerpt: Guests can also enjoy whiskey tastings, distillery tours and locally inspired dining at the on-property High West Distillery.

facts.text: Gracie's Farm supplies eggs for breakfast dishes and honey for cocktails at The Bar.
facts.excerpt: Eggs are collected fresh each morning and used in breakfast dishes and baked goods across the Lodge, while honey from our thriving hives sweetens craft cocktails at The Bar

facts.text: Tacocat Speakeasy is in a mountaintop yurt and serves Mexican small plates by Chef Guillermo Tellez on Mondays and Tuesdays.
facts.excerpt: Hidden in a secluded mountaintop yurt, Tacocat Speakeasy brings the bold flavors and the vibrant, playful spirit of Mexico to Blue Sky.

facts.text: The Tavern Breakfast Ride goes on horseback to The Tavern at Blue Sky, an original 1800s cabin where a Western-inspired breakfast is served.
facts.excerpt: en route to The Tavern at Blue Sky, an original 1800s cabin set within a pristine high-alpine field, where a Western-inspired breakfast awaits.

facts.text: The Tavern Breakfast Ride is available from June to October.
facts.excerpt: Available June – October

facts.text: Edge Spa is perched on a precipice overlooking Alexander Creek.
facts.excerpt: Aptly named for its dramatic location perched on the side of a dramatic precipice overlooking Alexander Creek, Edge Spa seeks to restore guests

facts.text: Edge Spa offers vertical vinyasa, aerial yoga with silk hung from tree branches in a forest.
facts.excerpt: vertical vinyasa: aerial yoga which uses large swaths of silk suspended from tree branches in a secluded forest

facts.text: Edge Sanctuary is a glamping tent in an aspen grove beside Alexander Creek, dedicated to energetic healing.
facts.excerpt: Tucked into a secluded aspen grove that is situated along the tranquil banks of Alexander Creek, the new Edge Sanctuary is a hidden haven that is dedicated to energetic and vibrational healing.

facts.text: Executive Chef Guillermo Tellez leads the culinary program.
facts.excerpt: The Blue Sky culinary program is helmed by Executive Chef Guillermo Tellez, a Mexico native

facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide named the hotel a Five-Star winner in 2022 through 2026.
facts.excerpt: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 & 2026 Five-Star Award Winner

facts.text: Yuta was named one of 2026's Best Restaurants for Wine by Wine Spectator.
facts.excerpt: One of 2026's Best Restaurants for Wine - Wine Spectator
